title: Degree bound for a low-degree truncation
statement: Let $n,d\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The Fourier coefficient family of the degree-$d$ truncation of $f$ vanishes on every subset $S\subseteq[n]$ with $|S|>d$; equivalently, that coefficient family has degree at most $d$.
